prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic high-contrast Japanese urban street portrait of an approved adult woman looking back over her shoulder.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with short sleek black pixie hair and pale skin, wearing a black spaghetti-strap dress with an open back and high slit, holding a silver smartphone with dark red nails. Preserve the reference's leafy neck tattoo, blackwork arm sleeve, natural proportions, and calm direct gaze.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft daylight with high contrast and shallow depth of field, crisp tattoo detail, warm storefront bokeh, realistic urban haze, and a bold alternative street-fashion mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm portrait lens look, sharp facial and tattoo detail, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, vertical 9:16.

She wears a black spaghetti-strap dress with an open back and high slit, holds a silver smartphone with dark red nails, and has a leafy black-ink neck tattoo and detailed blackwork sleeve.
